en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a town square with a two‑storey neoclassical building on the left, a one‑storey building in the center, and a tall bell tower with a cross on top to the right. Several people stand in the square. Printed French text at the top identifies it as a souvenir from Zante and notes a café. Handwritten script in dark ink appears over the image, and a watermark with a website address is visible at the bottom.
